deadline.value: Funding deadline January 6, 2027 (apply by this date to enter the University funding competition); the final application deadline is later, but too late for most funding.

toefl_min.value: TOEFL iBT 100 overall with at least 25 in each section; this course sets its own English level.
toefl_min.quote: TOEFL Internet Score Element Score Listening 25 Writing 25 Reading 25 Speaking 25 Total 100

ielts_min.value: IELTS Academic 7.0 overall (Listening 7.0, Writing 7.0, Reading 6.5, Speaking 7.0).
ielts_min.quote: IELTS (Academic) Element Score Listening 7.0 Writing 7.0 Reading 6.5 Speaking 7.0 Total 7.0

supervisor.value: Applicants are expected to have already identified and contacted the most suitable supervisor(s).
supervisor.quote: It is expected that applicants will have a good idea of the area of Earth Sciences in which they wish to conduct research and that they will have already identified and made contact with the most suitable supervisor(s).

funding.value: Eligible applicants are considered for NERC CREATES funding; no guaranteed funding.
funding.quote: eligible applicants for the PhD in Earth Sciences will be considered for funding through that scheme.

entry_route.value: Normally a good II.i first degree or a master's.
entry_route.quote: Applicants would normally have, or be expecting to attain, a good II.i class of first degree or a Master's degree.
